description: Header file defining the AppGatewayResponderImplementation class, which implements interfaces for app gateway response handling, including message dispatch, registration, and connection status management within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: AppGatewayResponderImplementation
classes.description: Implements app gateway responder and configuration interfaces, manages WebSocket message dispatch, registration, and connection status notifications.

classes.name: WsMsgJob
classes.description: Dispatch job for WebSocket messages, encapsulates method, params, request and connection IDs.

classes.name: RespondJob
classes.description: Dispatch job for sending response messages back through WebSocket.

classes.name: EmitJob
classes.description: Dispatch job for emitting notifications to WebSocket connections.

classes.name: RequestJob
classes.description: Dispatch job for sending requests over WebSocket.

classes.name: ConnectionStatusNotificationJob
classes.description: Dispatch job for handling connection status change notifications.

classes.name: AppIdRegistry
classes.description: Manages mapping between connection IDs and app IDs with thread safety.

methods.name: DispatchWsMsg
methods.description: Handles dispatching WebSocket messages based on method, params, request ID, and connection ID.

methods.name: ReturnMessageInSocket
methods.description: Sends a response payload back to a client over WebSocket connection.
